answer_1.quote: We revisited guided abstractive summarization of radiology reports... The task of summarizing radiology reports as follows. Given the findings section ... the goal is to generate an impression ... that accurately summarizes the most significant findings.
answer_1.outputs: Impression summaries (concise abstractive summaries of radiology findings)

answer_2.quote: We evaluate the quality of generated impressions with ROUGE F1 ... we also report BERTScore ... As factual correctness is critical, we also calculate a factuality F1 based on CheXpert.

answer_4.quote: We task annotators to highlight erroneous text spans and to classify them according to an error taxonomy. ... We hired 6 senior medical students ... Each set of summaries is completed by three annotators resulting in 1,200 error annotations.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators followed detailed annotation guidelines defining 11 fine‑grained error categories (omissions, additions, incorrect location, incorrect severity, other, etc.) and marked spans accordingly.
